headline: GREEN: HM rehearsal done, icu 87 vs 85. Sunday pace 4:40-4:45, rep 1 was too hot
summary: HRV 63 (down from 77, 7-day avg 70), RHR 44, sleep 6.3h. Post-session CTL 52.9, ATL 78.8, TSB -26. Reps: 4:23 / 4:34 / 4:41 per km at the same HR 168-169, max 176. Stop rule passed (rep 2 at 4:34 for 169bpm). The fade is pacing, not fitness: rep 1 went 15s/km under target and paid for it by rep 3. 1min reps ran 3:30-3:40/km vs 4:05-4:10 prescribed, max 188. Rest of Wk3 unchanged, week load 447 vs 455 planned.
flags: Sunday: km 1-5 no faster than 4:42/km, then 4:38-4:42 while HR stays under 174. Open up only after km 16. Projected 1:38-1:40.
Rep 1 overcooked is the Pirin start pattern (cramps km 12). Same fix: bank nothing in the first 20 minutes.
Thu aerobic: if Thu HRV is 70+, extend to 80min (load 75, +10). If under 60, cut to 50min.
